name: rallid-publisher
description: Scoped BlackRail page publishing skills for Rallid customers using Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Stage and publish BlackRail pages safely
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to a Rallid-hosted BlackRail staging site with narrowly scoped page credentials, review drafts, and require a separate human-approved production publishing token before anything goes live.
defaultPrompt: Connect my BlackRail staging site with $connect-rallid-site and verify its scoped token.
Use $publish-blackrail-pages to stage and review a page, then ask before any production write.
